title: Reverse a String Three Ways
hints: Prepending each character also reverses: `b = String(ch) + b`.
Recurse on `s.dropFirst()` (a `Substring`) and append the first character.
jsBridge: `String(s.reversed())` reverses **graphemes**, so emoji and accents survive. JS's `s.split('').reverse().join('')` breaks surrogate pairs. Three agreeing implementations are a mini property test.

compass.q: `'👨‍👩‍👧'.split('').reverse().join('')` in JS produces garbage. What does Swift's `reversed()` produce, and why?
`reversed()` (a lazy view) vs building a new `String`: when is the lazy view enough?
Reversing `unicodeScalars` vs `Character`s: which breaks flags like 🇬🇧?
Is string reversal ever needed in apps? What about right-to-left text (it's not reversal)?
